title: 泰勒·斯威夫特：新歌首秀像电影，为何请来科林·法瑞尔
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Christina Rufini, she is Bloomberg this weekend's host.
segments.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·鲁菲尼，她是彭博周末的主持人。

segments.en: You guys air every Saturday and Sunday's 7 a.m. to 10 a.m.
segments.zh: 你们每周六和周日早上7点到10点播出。

segments.en: We are here. We're doing everything. We're going to recap of the UN.
segments.zh: 我们在这里。我们正在做所有事情。我们将回顾联合国。

segments.en: We're going to look forward towards these Middle East negotiations. What's going on.
segments.zh: 我们将展望这些中东谈判。发生了什么。

segments.en: We're going to talk to you about, we have a fun story about how teeny tiny hotels are becoming really popular.
segments.zh: 我们将和你谈谈，我们有一个有趣的故事，关于微型酒店如何变得非常受欢迎。

segments.en: As people don't want to deal with taking out the trash in their Airbnb, but they want like some hotel services without being able to keep a resort using micro hotels.
segments.zh: 因为人们不想处理Airbnb的垃圾，但他们想要一些酒店服务，而不用去度假村，使用微型酒店。

segments.en: You can have a popular one. That's the thing in Japan with the capsule hotels.
segments.zh: 你可以有一个受欢迎的。这就是日本胶囊酒店的情况。

segments.en: So this is not small rooms. This is a small number of rooms.
segments.zh: 所以这不是小房间。这是少量房间。

segments.en: Like three and four rooms. It's like somebody's really fancy villa that they're now letting out and having a super luxury experience, but you also get to be there with some other people.
segments.zh: 像三四个房间。就像有人非常漂亮的别墅，他们现在出租，并提供超级豪华的体验，但你也可以和其他人一起在那里。

segments.en: And again, it's people are moving away from Airbnb's because of all the dramas.
segments.zh: 再说一次，人们正在远离Airbnb，因为所有的戏剧。

segments.en: Everything seems to be managed now, including Taylor Swift's latest.
segments.zh: 现在一切似乎都经过精心安排，包括泰勒·斯威夫特的最新动态。

segments.en: I mean, it's incredibly managed exercise. You're an hour ago.
segments.zh: 我是说，这是一场极其精心的运作。你一小时前就知道了。

segments.en: Well, anything she does has to be managed because whatever she does has such a big impact.
segments.zh: 嗯，她做的任何事都必须精心安排，因为她无论做什么影响都很大。

segments.en: You used to drop a record or drop this or drop that.
segments.zh: 过去你发一张唱片，或者发布这个那个。

segments.en: And that's over. Well, she's revealing a video at the MTV VMAs.
segments.zh: 那种时代结束了。嗯，她将在MTV音乐录影带大奖上首发一支视频。

segments.en: Was it video music awards? Yeah.
segments.zh: 是音乐录影带大奖吗？是的。

segments.en: I don't even know how you watch VMAs, these days.
segments.zh: 我都不知道现在你们怎么看音乐录影带大奖。

segments.en: I don't know, but I did see the video is going to have Colin Farrell and Dakota Johnson in it.
segments.zh: 我不知道，但我确实看到视频里会有科林·法瑞尔和达科塔·约翰逊。

segments.en: And I'm kind of Taylor Swift agnostic, but I do like Colin Farrell.
segments.zh: 我对泰勒·斯威夫特算是中立，但我确实喜欢科林·法瑞尔。

segments.en: I would watch him read the phone. That's the trailer, by the way. I will watch this video.
segments.zh: 我会看他读电话簿。顺便说一句，那是预告片。我会看这个视频的。

segments.en: I will watch this video. This looks like a movie.
segments.zh: 我会看这个视频。这像一部电影。
